info.title: OMS Compile Override Service
info.description:
Manage TD/OMS compile overrides and their command details.

Use this service to add, change, copy, delete, or authorize compile overrides. A compile override consists of a header plus one or more command details that run before, during, or after compilation.

Request behavior depends on `createCommandType`:

- `*HEADER` targets the compile override header.
- `*PRE`, `*COMPILE`, and `*POST` target individual command details.
- `*ALL` is only valid where the operation explicitly allows all command details to be addressed at once.

servers.description: Base URL for the OMS Compile Override Service.

port.description: The port to which the server is listening.

/add.summary: Add a compile override header or command detail.
/add.description:
Creates a compile override header or adds a command detail to an existing compile override.

When `createCommandType` is `*HEADER`, TD/OMS creates the header and automatically adds the default compile command detail.

post.summary: Add a compile override header or command detail.
post.description:
Creates a compile override header or command detail.

Use `*HEADER` to create the header. Use `*PRE`, `*COMPILE`, or `*POST` to add a command detail. Creating a header also creates the default command detail.

requestBody.description: Request payload for creating a compile override header or command detail.

400.description: The request was invalid or the compile override could not be created.

401.description: Authentication failed or the bearer token is missing or expired.

/change.summary: Change a compile override header or command detail.
/change.description: Updates a compile override header or one of its command details.

post.summary: Change a compile override header or command detail.
post.description:
Updates a compile override header or command detail.

Use `*HEADER` to update header-level fields. Use `*PRE`, `*COMPILE`, or `*POST` together with a sequence number to update a specific command detail.

requestBody.description: Request payload for updating a compile override header or command detail.

400.description: The request was invalid or the compile override could not be updated.

401.description: Authentication failed or the bearer token is missing or expired.

/copy.description: Copies a compile override header to a new target. The associated command details are copied automatically.

post.description: Copies a compile override header and all associated command details to the target object, application, environment, library, or member values supplied in the request.

requestBody.description: Request payload for copying a compile override and its command details.

copy.summary: How to specify the copy request input parameters value.

400.description: The request was invalid or the compile override could not be copied.

401.description: Authentication failed or the bearer token is missing or expired.

/delete.summary: Delete a compile override header or command detail.
/delete.description:
Deletes a compile override header or one or more command details.

Deleting with `createCommandType` set to `*HEADER` also removes all associated command details.

post.summary: Delete a compile override header or command detail.
post.description:
Deletes a compile override header or command detail.

Use `*HEADER` to remove the entire compile override. Use a detail-level `createCommandType` or `*ALL` where supported to remove command details only.

requestBody.description: Request payload for deleting a compile override header or command detail.

interfaceLevel.description: Interface level supported by this service. This API currently accepts only `V16R1M0`.

createCommandType.description:
Identifies which part of the compile override is targeted.

- `*HEADER`: target the compile override header.
- `*PRE`: target a pre-compile command detail.
- `*COMPILE`: target the compile command detail.
- `*POST`: target a post-compile command detail.
- `*ALL`: target all command details where the operation supports it.

For add and change requests, use `*HEADER` for header-level work and one of the detail values for command details.

createCommandSequenceNumber.description:
Sequence number of the command detail.

- `-1` (`*NEXT`): allocate the next available sequence number when adding a detail.
- `1` (`*ONLY`): identify the single compile command detail when `createCommandType` is `*COMPILE`.
- `-2` (`*ALL`): address all sequence numbers where the operation supports it, typically for delete requests.

Do not use `*NEXT` or `*ALL` where the operation rules disallow them.

behaviourOnError.description:
Controls when a command detail runs relative to earlier command failures.

- `*ALWAYS`: always run the command detail.
- `*NOTERROR`: run only when no prior command detail has failed.
- `*ERROR`: run only after a prior command detail has failed.
- `*SAME`: keep the current setting on change requests; for add requests the effective default is `*NOTERROR`.

commandString.description:
IBM i command string to execute for the command detail. TD/OMS substitution variables supported by action definitions may be used in the command text.

Use `*SAME` only on change requests to leave the existing command string unchanged.

createCommandType.description:
Identifies which part of the compile override to delete.

- `*HEADER`: delete the header and all associated command details.
- `*PRE`, `*COMPILE`, `*POST`: delete a specific command detail.
- `*ALL`: delete all command details while leaving the header in place, where supported.

createCommandSequenceNumber.description:
Sequence number of the command detail to delete.

Use `1` (`*ONLY`) with `*COMPILE` for the single compile command detail. Use `-2` (`*ALL`) only when deleting all applicable sequence numbers is supported by the request.
